game_title: Type Sorter – Ash Rim Trail Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Mt. Pyre – Ash Rim Trail, the crumbling rim of Mt. Pyre: the fire warden must handle magma slimes while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Type Sorter: Sort falling obsidian shards into bins labelled int, float, str and bool before they hit the ground.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Ash Rim Trail: the crumbling rim of Mt. Pyre
core_gameplay_loop: In Ash Rim Trail, repeat each round: Sort falling obsidian shards into bins labelled int, float, str and bool before they hit the ground. Each round, magma slimes strike the magma valve, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the sorted_ok value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the magma valve from magma slimes in Ash Rim Trail: keep the sorted_ok meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 42-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: sorted_ok drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 42-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 1 (intro tier): Type Sorter
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how sorted_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against magma slimes in Ash Rim Trail.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 42 seconds while sorted_ok > 0.
